description: Build a shared React/Next/Vinext activity system for interactive video, diagrams, timestamped formative questions, cloned tutorial repositories, deterministic step checks, and Mastery practice evidence.
deviation_notes: The technical vertical slice and browser walkthrough completed before named product-owner approval. Daniel Bo explicitly approved the learner and teacher evidence experience on 2026-07-11.

sprint.goal: Deliver reusable I Do and We Do activity infrastructure that turns video checkpoints, diagrams, tutorial steps, checks, hints, and replays into one accessible and scaffold-aware evidence stream.
sprint.demo_notes: Shared React video, tutorial repository, persistence, and Codecamp vertical-slice browser evidence passed and received product-owner approval.
